description: Tauri desktop wrapper of Ketcher with a native Indigo sidecar

activities.name: windows-build-without-imago
activities.title: Add a Windows x86_64 build without Imago
activities.description: Build and package Chemistry Draw for Windows using native Indigo, with Imago compiled out and image recognition disabled.
acceptance: Windows CI builds an NSIS installer on windows-latest and uploads it as an artifact
The Windows sidecar links native Indigo/Indigo Renderer DLLs and starts successfully; /v2/info returns an empty imago_versions array
Imago routes and worker are absent on Windows; /v2/imago/uploads returns 404
Linux build and harness remain green
README/docs describe Windows prerequisites, build command, and the no-Imago limitation

tasks.description: Document Windows build constraints, pinned Indigo 1.46.0, no-Imago behavior and verification steps

Make the sidecar cross-platform: target-specific build.rs, Windows Imago stub/gating, portable parent watchdog
Split Tauri platform configs and add Windows bundle metadata, resources, externalBin and host DLL PATH handling
Add Windows CI job: harness, sidecar smoke test, NSIS build and artifact upload
Run the Windows CI job on a pushed commit, verify the NSIS artifact and smoke tests, and fix any Windows-only failures
Final review of the Windows build and CI artifact against acceptance criteria

activities.name: enforce-docs-test-implement

Policy tests cover valid, missing and misordered phases
AGENTS.md, README, docs/testing.md, docs/conventions.md, docs/verification.md, docs/CHECKPOINTS.md, docs/DEVELOPMENT.md and agent prompts document the order
Harness and policy tests are green
